explication: ccNexus is a cross-platform Claude Code/Codex proxy with desktop and headless-server entry points. Its main workflow accepts client API requests, selects an endpoint, transforms formats as needed, and forwards requests; configuration, credentials, persistence, and usage statistics support that flow. Desktop and server interfaces expose endpoint and statistics management, while README-documented capabilities include Codex token pools, model listing, Basic Auth, and WebDAV sync. Some runtime wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so uncertain links are omitted or marked unverified.
